import json
from pathlib import Path
def add_item(path, item):
    p = Path(path)
    items = json.loads(p.read_text()) if p.exists() else []
    items.append(item)
    p.write_text(json.dumps(items))
    return items

import os
def save(path, text):
    tmp = str(path) + ".tmp"
    with open(tmp, "w") as f:
        f.write(text)
        f.flush()
        os.fsync(f.fileno())
    os.replace(tmp, path)
